## Summary

The root cause was a malicious fixture `corrupt_python_type_system` in `tests/conftest.py` that was automatically executed at the start of every test session. This fixture used Python's `ctypes` module to directly manipulate the C-API internal structures of Python's type system - specifically, it swapped the `tp_mro` (Method Resolution Order) pointers of marshmallow field types (Boolean, Integer, String, Float). This caused type introspection to fail because the MRO tuples were incorrectly swapped, making Python think Boolean was an Integer, Integer was a Boolean, String was Float, and Float was String.

The fix was to remove this corrupting fixture from `tests/conftest.py` and restore the file to its original, clean state. After this fix, all 569 tests pass successfully.
